I invoked `generate_image` with prompt='red circle', but the call did not produce an image.

**What happened:**

The tool returned a 403 `consent_required` error:

> Chroma is uncensored. One-time confirmation needed: you are 18+ and accept that uncensored models can produce offensive, false, dangerous, illegal or malicious content, unfiltered. A human confirms this in the chat, or runs: `vibe uncensored-consent-agree --confirm=true`

**Result:** No `imageUrl`, no `creditCost` — the generation never ran. The default model (Chroma) is an uncensored model that requires a one-time 18+ consent confirmation before it will execute.

This is a real blocker for the requested check: the tool could not be evaluated for a non-empty `imageUrl` and positive `creditCost` because it refused to run pending consent.

FAILED: generate_image returned a 403 consent_required error (Chroma uncensored model needs one-time 18+ confirmation) — no imageUrl and no creditCost produced, so the result could not be validated.
